subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language ‘BOTTLE’ is written as ‘148’, ‘SIPPER’ is written as ‘166’. How will ‘BUMPER’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Sum of the position values according to the English alphabetical series is multiplied by (2).

​So,

 
• ‘BOTTLE’ is written as ‘148’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35f2f2351ce2b784512fac172a8bd7edc6337c767f1c218afe7d7f3a5e3927fd.png] 

​And,

 
• ‘SIPPER’ is written as ‘166’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a265a73c119004288898bfa487c6084f1401718b50d05c3442e36bf712c8ba6.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘BUMPER’ is written as :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb51f420803efb68115a70fbc5bab2a5059b2055f0a5f7f33b8b4daaa9ff27f2.png] 

Hence, "150" is the correct answer.
